integrity_statement: Analytic proof supplies the universal result. Exact rational enumeration certifies only the fixed affine-regular reference hexagon. Self-review is not independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Sharp chord inequality holds for centrally symmetric genuine hexagons and planar one-fold translative tiles, not arbitrary polygons. Exact profile concerns only edge-direction parallelograms; the full chord optimum need not equal it for arbitrary hexagons. Potential equivalent older edge-direction statements in inaccessible classical literature remain possible.
title: Sharp edge-direction enclosure of centrally symmetric hexagons
